declaration-no-important.message: Disallowed !important. Only src/design-system/tokens.css may use it, for its prefers-reduced-motion override (WCAG 2.3.3)

declaration-property-value-allowed-list.message: Property "%s" has disallowed value "%s". Feature CSS uses only design tokens: var(--token) with no fallback, or 0, none, auto, inherit, currentColor, transparent

function-allowed-list.message: Disallowed function "%s". Feature CSS may call only var(--token)

color-no-hex.message: Disallowed hex color "%s". Use a colour token from src/design-system/tokens.css

color-named.message: Disallowed named color "%s". Use a colour token from src/design-system/tokens.css

property-disallowed-list.message: Disallowed property "%s". Feature code lays out only through the Stack, Inline and Grid primitives from src/design-system

media-feature-name-allowed-list.message: Disallowed media feature "%s". Feature CSS has no breakpoints: responsive layout comes only from the Stack, Inline and Grid primitives in src/design-system. A feature media query may test only the keyword user preferences prefers-reduced-motion, prefers-reduced-transparency, prefers-contrast, prefers-color-scheme, forced-colors and inverted-colors

media-feature-name-value-allowed-list.message: Media feature "%s" has disallowed value "%s". A user-preference query in feature CSS takes only that feature's keyword values

at-rule-disallowed-list.message: Disallowed at-rule "%s". Feature CSS has no container queries, custom media or @import, because each can carry a breakpoint: responsive layout comes only from the Stack, Inline and Grid primitives in src/design-system

no-unknown-custom-media.message: Unknown custom media query "%s". Feature CSS has no breakpoints, so it defines and references no custom media: responsive layout comes only from the Stack, Inline and Grid primitives in src/design-system

color-no-hex.message: Disallowed hex color "%s". Use a colour token from src/design-system/tokens.css

color-named.message: Disallowed named color "%s". Use a colour token from src/design-system/tokens.css

function-disallowed-list.message: Disallowed colour function "%s". Colours come only from tokens in src/design-system/tokens.css

declaration-property-value-allowed-list.message: Property "%s" has disallowed value "%s". Colour, spacing, typography (the font shorthand included), radius, box and text shadow and z-index values are var(--token) with no fallback, or 0, none, auto, inherit, currentColor, transparent. Positional insets (inset, inset-*, top, right, bottom, left) take those values, a percentage, or calc() over var(--token), unitless numbers and percentages

media-feature-name-disallowed-list.message: Disallowed media feature "%s". Component CSS has no breakpoints of its own: responsive layout comes from the Grid primitive and PageShell, whose Grid.css and PageShell.css alone hold the documented 48rem Grid breakpoint. Width, height, inline-size, block-size, aspect-ratio and device-width/height conditions are disallowed here; keyword preference queries such as prefers-reduced-motion stay allowed

at-rule-disallowed-list.message: Disallowed at-rule "%s". Component CSS has no container queries or custom media, because each can carry a breakpoint other than the 48rem one that Grid.css documents

no-unknown-custom-media.message: Unknown custom media query "%s". Component CSS defines no custom media, so the documented 48rem Grid breakpoint is written out, in Grid.css and PageShell.css only

media-feature-name-disallowed-list.message: Disallowed media feature "%s". Grid.css and PageShell.css break only at the documented 48rem Grid breakpoint, a width or height condition; viewport-shape (aspect-ratio) and device-size (device-width, device-height) queries carry other breakpoints

media-feature-name-value-allowed-list.message: Media feature "%s" has disallowed value "%s". Grid.css and PageShell.css hold the one documented Grid breakpoint, so every width and height condition in them is exactly 48rem
